campaign.name: Weight-8 2D-local codes, n=700-1000
campaign.notes: Above n=700 the board only admits check weight <= 8 with d <= 40, which is why the weight cap and the blocklength window are what they are: outside that box a find cannot be submitted at all. The locality constraint is reachable only through a generator that emits per-qubit coordinates, which is why the generators are the boundary engine and its layout helper rather than a torus sampler: the verifier reads the locality class off the layout, and a code submitted without one lands in the unrestricted cell. n = 2*Lx*Ly before cleanup, so the window needs Lx*Ly in [350, 500]. Weight 8 needs boundary_engine rather than planar.build_open_directional, which covers weight-6 families only. There is deliberately no frontier_advance stop: this is a sweep of a cell, and one advance is a reason to keep going, not to stop.
